correctness.rationale: Direct incidence matrix-unit multiplication reduces triple equations to a hollow symmetric matrix. Every nonzero hollow symmetric 3x3 matrix has rank >=2; determinant 2uvw gives the exact rank2/rank3 frequencies in each characteristic. The Gaussian factorization-fiber calculation counts each pair (A,B) once. Free central parameters multiply by q^3. Finite exhaustive programs verify q=2,3,5 for width1, q=2,3 for width2, q=2 for width3, and separately F4 width1.

The exact ordered-triple count for arbitrary width m and all finite fields has a nontrivial characteristic-dependent rank-three contribution. It is a complete natural point-count invariant, not a minor isolated enumerative slice.
